title: Lipiecki and Weron, Foundation models for electricity price forecasting and battery arbitrage (abstract page)
note: Fetched abstract page, v1 submitted 31 Aug 2026, cs.LG. Nine zero-shot variants from five foundation model families against two electricity price benchmarks in Germany, Poland and Spain, 2021 to 2025. Only the TabPFN models beat the benchmarks consistently and significantly on all statistical measures; in battery arbitrage the DDNN benchmark earns more at lower risk tolerance.

title: Lipiecki and Weron, full text v1: design
note: Full text read up to the reference list. Target: hourly day-ahead prices (DE-LU, PL, ES bidding zones), 24 prices for the next day issued once a day. Data 6 Jan 2017 to 31 Dec 2025, test 1 Jan 2021 to 31 Dec 2025 (1,826 days). Models: Chronos-2, Chronos-2-synth, Chronos-2-small, Moirai-2, TimesFM-2.5, TabPFN-2, TabPFN-3, TabPFN-TS-3, Mitra+CP. Benchmarks: LEAR+CP and DDNN-JSU.

title: Lipiecki and Weron, full text v1: inputs
note: Inputs: ENTSO-E day-ahead load and wind plus solar forecasts as known-future covariates, and carbon, gas, oil and coal futures closes lagged two days; no weather series. TabPFN-2, TabPFN-3, Mitra and both benchmarks get the same lagged feature set; DDNN-JSU uses the same 1,449-day context as TabPFN-2/3. Moirai-2 gets no covariates; TimesFM-2.5 gets them through XReg.

title: Lipiecki and Weron, full text v1: accuracy tables
note: Tables 3 to 5, CRPS 2021 to 2025: TabPFN-3 9.15 (DE), 9.61 (PL), 8.15 (ES) against DDNN-JSU 10.70, 10.96, 9.30 (about 14.5%, 12.3%, 12.4% lower). TabPFN-3 MAE 12.59, 13.25, 11.18 against 14.58, 14.97, 12.66. All three TabPFN variants beat DDNN-JSU at the 1% level (one-sided CPA test) on MAE, RMSE and CRPS in every market. Chronos-2 CRPS 11.80, 10.74, 9.46: significant in Poland only.

title: Lipiecki and Weron, full text v1: arbitrage tables
note: Battery arbitrage (1 MWh, efficiency 0.95, 25 EUR per cycle), total profit 2021 to 2025. Unlimited bids: TabPFN-TS-3 leads in DE (132,716 EUR against DDNN-JSU 130,434) and ES, TabPFN-3 in PL. Quantile strategy at the 60% and 50% levels: DDNN-JSU leads in all three markets (DE 50%: 86,123 against TabPFN-3 80,768). Authors: profits are not proper scores; gaps between leaders are small.

title: Lipiecki and Weron, full text v1: limits
note: Authors' limits: three markets, one battery setup, one strategy family; contamination cannot be ruled out for models pretrained on real series (not TabPFN or Chronos-2-synth). Data from ENTSO-E and Investing.com. The text names no code repository, forecast archive or pre-registration. Table 1: TabPFN-3 and TabPFN-TS-3 (May 2026) and Moirai-2 are not free for commercial use.

title: Prior-Labs/tabpfn_3 (model card)
note: Card: TabPFN-3 is trained only on synthetic tabular tasks; inference code is the tabpfn package. The time-series checkpoint is fine-tuned on synthetic series and is the TabPFN-TS-3 default. The licence allows research, testing and internal benchmarking but no commercial or production use of the model or its outputs; a commercial licence is sold separately.
